$comment: assetsvc's model roster for the Docker install. The cluster's roster (deploy/helm/assetsvc
values.yaml) names in-cluster Services; here there are none, so every url is EMPTY and the
real one arrives from the environment, which the core writes from deploy/docker/.env:
PIEDMONT_IMAGE_MODEL_KEY  -> FLUX_API_KEY             sent as Authorization: Bearer, if set
PIEDMONT_MESH_MODEL_KEY   -> TRELLIS_API_KEY          sent as Authorization: Bearer, if set
Unset, the model reports `no url configured` and generation is off; nothing else is affected.
The optional AI stack (deploy/docker/ai) serves both; any host speaking the same API will do.
